issue.title: Increased memory requirements for native-image compilation with Quarkus master

labels.name: triage/out-of-date
labels.description: This issue/PR is no longer valid or relevant

issue.body:
We see increased memory requirements in BeefyTS  (module 003-quarkus-many-extensions) for native-image compilation with Quarkus master comparing to Quarkus 1.12.2.Final

Run with Quarkus 1.12.2.Final finishes successfully, run with Quarkus master finishes with `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded`. We use `-Dquarkus.native.native-image-xmx=4g` in our GitHub Action.

I was able to identify that quarkus-kubernetes / quarkus-openshift extension pulls in additional 10+ MB of dependencies - filed https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/15705. This is affecting native-image execution because more classes need to be analyzed and thus increases pressure on heap space.

The problem is not only quarkus-kubernetes / quarkus-openshift extension. When I removed `quarkus-kubernetes` extension from 003-quarkus-many-extensions module I was able to get the native binary with `-Dquarkus.native.native-image-xmx=4g` setting.
But the build takes longer comparing to 1.12.2.Final, 08:47 min for Quarkus master versus 07:41 min for Quarkus 1.12.2.Final.
This is something to be tackled on Quarkus side to identify other extensions which are causing increased memory requirements.

Investigation of native-image related issues is really problematic, takes time and overloads the machine for several minutes. I tried few native builds with different sets of extensions to see how 1.12.2.Final and Quarkus master differs. In the end I went back to JVM mode and compared pulled jars to identify quarkus-kubernetes issue.
I miss something handy which would provide more details when comparing two builds of the native-image.
This is something to be tackled preferable by Mandrel team, or maybe escalated by them to upstream for wider discussion. 
@galderz fyi^

Reproducer:
```
git clone git@github.com:quarkus-qe/beefy-scenarios.git
cd beefy-scenarios && git checkout e83bcc8

mvn -s .github/mvn-settings.xml clean package -DskipTests -Dnative \
    -Dquarkus.native.container-build=true -Dquarkus.native.native-image-xmx=4g \
    -Dquarkus.platform.version=1.12.2.Final -Dquarkus-plugin.version=1.12.2.Final  \
    -Dquarkus.native.builder-image=quay.io/quarkus/ubi-quarkus-native-image:21.0-java11 \
    -pl '003-quarkus-many-extensions'

mvn -s .github/mvn-settings.xml clean package -DskipTests -Dnative \
    -Dquarkus.native.container-build=true -Dquarkus.native.native-image-xmx=4g \
    -Dquarkus.platform.version=999-SNAPSHOT -Dquarkus-plugin.version=999-SNAPSHOT  \
    -Dquarkus.native.builder-image=quay.io/quarkus/ubi-quarkus-native-image:21.0-java11 \
    -pl '003-quarkus-many-extensions'
```

body: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/15706 is how I noticed quarkus-kubernetes / quarkus-openshift problem.  It seems there are more extensions which are causing increased memory requirements for native build with Quarkus master.
